worldcombat.skill.psychic.summary: Seize the aimed enemy with telekinesis: root it in place, deal special damage on the grab and possibly lower its Sp. Def by 1 stage; during a short manipulation window, hold the skill key to steer the telekinetic anchor around the target so it is dragged after the anchor; if it is still held when the window ends, crush it once.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.0: Pick out one high-threat target at mid range
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.1: Pin a charging enemy in place
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.2: Drag a target away from an ally, a doorway or the middle of a corridor
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.0: A landed grab deals about %1$s special damage; as long as the grab holds and the target stays in range with clear sight, it takes about %2$s more when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.1: The telekinesis pins the target in place, unable to move, for %1$s; over the following %3$s manipulation window, holding the skill key steers the telekinetic anchor within %2$s blocks of the initial spot, and the target is pushed toward it — up to %2$s blocks of total movement (bigger bodies resist). Without manual aim it is dragged toward the caster. If it is still held when the window ends, the crush lands.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.2: A landed grab has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.psychic.hold.on: Coiling grip: longer root, larger manipulation budget, heavier crush and a more reliable Sp. Def drop, at the cost of slightly lighter grab, shorter reach and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.hold.off: Point grip: a longer, faster, heavier grab, at the cost of a shorter root, a smaller manipulation budget, a lighter crush and a rarer Sp. Def drop.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.growth.0: From level %1$s the grab rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.growth.1: From level %1$s the grab rises to %2$s power and %3$s Sp. Def drop chance.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.preference.hol: On: root x1.5, crush x1.25, manipulation budget x1.2, Sp. Def drop x1.3, but grab x0.94, reach x0.85, +3 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — hold a target down longer. Off (point grip): a longer, faster, heavier grab, at the cost of a shorter root, a smaller manipulation budget, a lighter crush and a rarer Sp. Def drop.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before focusing; larger values let it open from further away.
On: targets already rooted or asleep are ranked last, saving the grip for a foe that can still move. Off: all targets are equal.
On: targets attacking the companion or its owner rank higher — pin and drag the most dangerous one aside. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.fa: If the grab does not land, it neither pins the target nor opens a manipulation window, and no crush follows; losing sight or the target leaving the grip range makes the caster let go, so the crush does not land either. The crush depends only on whether this grab landed, not on the target accepting the root.
